_about: Business rules for the claim pipeline. Edit here, not in code. Path override: PIPELINE_RULES env var.

CLAIM_FORM.description: medical insurance claim / bill (e.g. CMS-1500, UB-04): billed procedures, diagnoses, charges, provider

fields.policy_number: string (the insured's own policy / member ID: UB-04 box 60 'Insured Unique ID', CMS-1500 box 1a 'Insured's ID Number'; never the employer group number: UB-04 box 57/62, CMS-1500 box 11, often GRP-...)
fields.physician_signature: string (signing physician) or null if unsigned

ID_DOCUMENT.description: identity or insurance card: driver's licence, state ID, passport, Medicare card, insurer member card

fields.card_marked_invalid: boolean (the card itself states it is expired, invalid or not valid for benefits)

DISCHARGE_SUMMARY.description: hospital discharge summary / report: admission, discharge, diagnoses, hospital course

fields.prior_discharge_date: date (an earlier stay mentioned, if any)

PRESCRIPTION.description: prescription written by a prescriber: medicines, sig, refills, prescriber signature

POLICY_AMENDMENT.description: insurer form requesting a change to a policy (endorsement / amendment request)

_page_order: Pages are classified, then read (preprocess + extract), in this order of document type. Before classification the type comes from the type chosen at upload, else from a filename_hints word in the file name; pages with no hint are classified last. Reading uses the classified type, UNKNOWN last. Ties keep upload order.

kyc._about: KYC's main check: the claimant's name is a member (no -> reject). An insurance card that is not valid (expired before the treatment date, prints an expired status, or is marked not valid) sends the claim to human review. Every other identity check is a fraud tag.

_duplicate_review: true: a claim whose patient already has a stored claim with the same date of service and amount is escalated to human review as a duplicate.

policy.retrieval_query: excluded procedures and excluded CPT code ranges
